name: What is involved in popcorn ceiling removal?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in popcorn ceiling removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Popcorn ceiling removal typically involves preparing the work area by covering floors and furniture, then thoroughly wetting the popcorn texture to soften it. Once soft, the material is carefully scraped off. After removal, the ceiling surface is inspected for damage, patched as needed, and often skim-coated to achieve a smooth finish before priming and painting. This process helps modernize a room and can improve indoor air quality by removing dated textures that may harbor dust.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popcorn ceiling removal involves prepping the area, wetting and scraping the texture, then repairing and finishing the ceiling for a smooth surface.
